question.text: The horizontal component of earth's magnetic field at a place is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>5</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">T</mi></math>. A very long straight conductor carrying current of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math> in the direction from South east to North West is placed. The force per unit length experienced by the conductor is ________<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>6</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>.

solution.text:
Horizontal component of magnetic field, BH=3.5×10-5 T

Force acting on wire, F=ilBsinθ, where i=2 A

Therefore, Fl=iBsinθ=2×3.5×10-5×12

=35×10-6 N m-1
